newsitem.title: USA: Saks Holdings Inc completes notes offering.
newsitem.headline: Saks Holdings Inc completes notes offering.

text.p: Saks Holdings Inc, the holding company for Saks Fifth Avenue, said Friday it completed its offering of $240 million of 5.5 percent convertible subordinated notes due September 15, 2006.
The underwriters have an over-allotment option to purchase an additional $36 million aggregate principal amount of the notes, the company said.

The notes are convertible at any time prior to maturity, at the option of the holder, into shares of common stock of Saks Holdings Inc, at a conversion rate of 24.0601 shares per each $1,000 principal amount of notes, the company said.
In addition, the company said it completed an offering of 8 million shares of common stock sold by certain stockholders at a price of $33.25 per share.
The underwriters have an over-allotment option to purchase an additional 1.2 million common shares from the selling stockholders.
The stock was up 3/8 at 33-5/8 in active mid morning trading.
